
This is an analysis of a database that includes `r nrow(dat_raw)` ECGs 
on `r extract_n_subj(dat_raw)` individual patients from `r age_range` years 
of age who were pregnant at least once between 2011 to 2024 in a single 
tertiary medical center. After excluding 4 records for pregnant patients <18 
years of age, our analytic dataset includes `r nrow(dat)` ECGs from 
`r extract_n_subj(dat)` patients.  

## Statistical Analysis

The association between four between four ECG features and pregnancy status 
(binary) was assessed using mixed effects logistic regression with a random 
effect for pregnancy.  
\
The relationships between pregnancy trimester (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5) and ECG 
features were assessed through linear mixed effects models with a random effect 
for pregnancy. A separate model was fit for each ECG feature.
